Name: Slimes in Stardew
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][/center][center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][color=#ffadc5][size=5]Dependencies﻿ and Installation[/size][/color]
You must be running Stardew Valley version 1.6+.
Download the .zip file under Files and extract the contents to your Mods folder.

[i]You must install the following mods in order for this mod to function.[/i]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]

[i]You must install the following mods if...[/i]
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20619]Custom Bush[/url] ...if enabling "Crops" in the config file of this mod.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536]Mail Framework Mod[/url] ...if downloading the optional "Slimes in Stardew - Mail" file.


[color=#ffadc5][size=5]FAQ: What This Mod Is[/size][/color]
To put it simply, this is [i]"a huge Content Patcher mod which brings slimes, hen hens, crops, and other items
from the game Slime Rancher into Stardew Valley."

To be more specific:[/i] this mod adds all of the ranchable 14 slimes (+ Puddle and Fire slimes), variants of Hen Hens,
vegetables, fruit, and a recipe.

For more information on each, see the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/2262]Articles page[/url]﻿. [i]Or[/i], play through the mod and find out yourself! :)


[color=#ffadc5][size=5]Configurations[/size][/color]
[i]This is a [u]highly[/u] configurable mod. I recommend installing the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod to easily config this mod.

﻿[/i]Please note some important configurations:
- If you disable "Livestock Slimes", you should not install the optional "Slimes in Stardew - Mail" file.
- If you disable "Hen Livestock",  you should not install the optional "Slimes in Stardew - Mail" file.
- If you disable "Crops",  you should not install the optional "Slimes in Stardew - Mail" file.

Besides that, please feel free to configure the mod in any way you wish!


[color=#ffadc5][size=5]Compatibilities[/size][/color]
[i]This mod is automatically compatible with the following very helpful mods:[/i]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21414]Ferngill Simple Economy
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿
﻿[url=https://github.com/Annosz/UIInfoSuite2]UI Info Suite 2[/url]﻿﻿


[color=#ffadc5][size=5]Future Work[/size][/color]
[s]In the future, I would like to:

- Create a custom farm layout, "The Far, Far Range" which comes with a Coop and Slime Hutch.
- Create better assets for the fruits, vegetables, and their plant growth sprites.
- Add a bundle to the Community Center.
- Add slime accessories and clothing for use with Fashion Sense.
- Aquarium functionality for Puddle and Fire Slimes.[/s]

This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.
Please note the Fan Content Policy of Monomi Park, LLC if you work on this mod.

[color=#ffadc5][size=5]Translations[/size][/color]
This mod is currently available in English, Russian, Mandarin Chinese, and Portuguese.
I welcome any translators who would like to translate the mod to other languages, and would appreciate it!
There is support for i18n for ease of translation.


[color=#ffadc5][size=5]Known Issues[/size][/color]
If using the UI Info Suite mod, Kookadoba bushes will display as "Tea Saplings".
This has no effect on actually growing Kookadoba fruits.
